scene: You ride the escalator up to the busy, sunlit street-level transit plaza.
picture: Flat side view of the wide sunlit transit plaza along one ground line. Far left, a koi-shaped boat floats at a canal dock. Left of centre, the grandfather with his bicycle, plant crate, and tied bento parcel. Centre, an ivy-draped garden tram waits. Far right, a shiny red streetcar sits beside its signpost.
shown: A carved wooden koi-shaped boat moored at a stone dock on the far left.
A green tram covered in climbing ivy with open doors at the centre.
A bright red vintage streetcar waiting at a platform on the far right.
